company.name: Edge Impulse
company.shortDescription: Edge Impulse is the platform for developing intelligent devices using embedded machine learning.
company.description: Edge Impulse is a software platform that simplifies the development of ML models that are optimized for the edge, where data is collected, with or without connectivity. It offers the power to seamlessly manage machine learning for the edge, including data acquisition, signal processing, ML training, model testing, and creating a deployable model that can run efficiently on an edge device from MCU to CPU to GPU.

productsAndServices.description: A development and deployment platform for collecting sensor data, building datasets, training machine-learning models, optimizing them for device constraints, and deploying inference to edge hardware.
productsAndServices.name: Edge AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: A computer-vision solution for building and deploying edge AI models that identify defects, verify components, and support automated inspection on industrial cameras and other edge systems.
productsAndServices.name: Visual Inspection Suite

productsAndServices.description: An OEM integration offering that embeds Edge Impulse’s model-development and deployment capabilities into a company’s own branded platform, products, or customer workflow.
productsAndServices.name: Edge Impulse for OEMs

productsAndServices.description: Expert-led services that help organizations develop, validate, optimize, and deploy embedded machine-learning solutions from proof of concept through production.
productsAndServices.name: Edge AI Product Development Services

aiResearchSummary.text: Edge Impulse is engaged in developing systems for embedded machine learning, as shown by work on an anomaly detection system for embedded devices that processes sensor data from sources like cameras or microphones, and on determining values for digital signal processing components to generate features for machine learning. These efforts focus on enabling intelligent data analysis and feature extraction directly on resource-constrained devices.
